programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: La señora Guerra seduce a David con regalos caros, lo que despierta la envidia en otros niños. David huye y corre peligro. Alejandro lo rescata, pero la minera enfurecida amenaza a los hombres del pueblo, que instigan en sus hijos el odio hacia ella.

programme.title: La patrona

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.desc: Romance and intrigue combine with the mystery of a famous international jewel as The Love Boat sails amid the scenic beauty of the Aegean Sea - including the glorious sights of the Greek Islands and Turkey.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.desc: While the Pacific Princess sails through the beautiful waters of Italy, a seemingly happy couple (Shelly Winters and Ernest Borgnine) reveals that their relationship is far from perfect.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.desc: Love, adventure and romantic hijinks are afloat when The Love Boat sails to the beautiful Eternal City of Rome and the sites of glorious Capri and Venice in a special two-hour premiere.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: Same Wavelength/ Winning Isn't Everything/ A Honeymoon For Horace
programme.desc: A mindreader meets a man and uses the reading to improve her chances at getting his attention. Meanwhile, Capt. Stubing's friend brags about his son's accomplishments, but Vicki hears a totally different story.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: Too Many Dads/ Love Will Find A Way/ The Best Of Friends
programme.desc: A 10-year-old boy is torn between his biological father, who he hasn't seen since he was a baby, and the stepfather who raised him. Meanwhile, Elaine tries to tell her parents that her fiance is a paraplegic.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: The Tomorrow Lady/ Father, Dear Father/ Still Life
programme.desc: A woman's (Greer Garson) ability to see the future may hinder her relationship with an attractive man. Plus, a single mother thinks she meets a divorced man traveling with his daughter, but that's not exactly the case.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.desc: Angelorum Dominicus suddenly appears aboard the Pacific Princess without a reservation and soon begins to spread love and happiness to everyone on the cruise, especially a little boy in need of an operation.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: The Groupies/ The Audition/ Doc'S Nephew
programme.desc: A female producer is adamant about not wanting to start a relationship with an actor, but the thespian has other plans. Meanwhile, a therapist goes on a cruise with his group, while Doc and his nephew compete for the affection of the same woman.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: The Captain's Replacement/ Sly As A Fox/ Here Comes The Bride -- Maybe
programme.desc: When Gopher suspects a skipper under Capt. Stubing's tutelage is trying to take his job, the crew jumps into action to protect their boss. Meanwhile, a lovely lady causes havoc when she boards with two men who are each after her hand.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: Gopher's Daisy/ Our Son, The Lawyer/ Salvaged Romance
programme.desc: A woman's (Joan Rivers) shyness around men is exacerbated by her recent mastectomy that is until she meets an understanding man. Meanwhile, when a married couple contemplates divorce, it's their son, who's also a lawyer, that gets caught in the middle.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: Fountain Of Youth/ Bad Luck Cabin/ Uncle Daddy
programme.desc: When an elderly man's granddaughter falls for one of his fresh-faced friends, the man seeks out some of the youth potion for himself. Meanwhile, things start moving a little too fast for Isaac and the woman he's dating.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: The Professor Has Class/ When The Magic Disappears/ We, The Jury
programme.desc: A sarcastic woman (Anne Meara) goes on a rampage when she finds out she's on a cruise with the same man she's suing (Jerry Stiller) for damages. Meanwhile, a famous professor meets a former student who is hired to replace his mentor/

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: The Captain's Crush/ Out Of My Hair/ Off-Course Romance
programme.desc: When Stubing meets a gorgeous movie queen (Joan Collins), who recently shed her ninth husband, he is fascinated by her charm and beauty. Then, a man decides to prioritize golf over his wife, so the neglected woman decides to play ball with an old friend.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: Discount Romance/ Vicky'S Dilemma/ Loser, And Still Champ
programme.desc: The captain's daughter is put in a tough situation she is accused of stealing supplements from Doc's office. Then, Gopher's uncle (Red Button) falls in love with the lady who runs the ship's gift shop.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: So Help Me Hannah/ The Maid Cleans Up/ Cpr, I.O.U
programme.desc: The vivacious Hannah Harvye (Mary Martin) immediately becomes involved with the crew and rekindles a romance with an old flame. An unassuming man (Ben Murphy) finds himself in a tight situation with a maid he's never met. Gopher saves a man's life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas develops temporary amnesia from a head injury while visiting a strange town and mistakenly assumes the identity of a wanted criminal.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A former neighbor of the McCains' is released from jail after serving his sentence for robbery. Lucas lets the man work for him but the new hand holds a secret.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Lucas, Mark, and Micah get lost in Old Mexico, they are held hostage by a group of bandits who intend to kill the men and take Mark as a slave.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: While trapped in the ghost town saloon, Lucas tries to come up with a plan to escape with his son and Micah after Mark refuses to leave without him.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lou Mallory arrives in North Fork and starts buying up land and businesses. Lou and Lucas start disliking each other after she reveals plans to build a railroad on "worthless" land.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When a woman arrives in North Fork with symptoms of smallpox, Lucas, Lou Mallory, Doctor Burrage, and hotel occupants are quarantined in the hotel with an outlaw.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Gunslinger Johnny Drako rides into town and tells the bartender that he is looking for Lucas McCain. After Johnny leaves the saloon, Sweeney hurries to tell Lucas.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A man arrives in North Fork, intending to marry Lou Mallory. The hotel owner looks for a way out from marrying the man to whom her dying father promised her.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: An assassination plot unfolds as four gunmen disguised as cavalrymen enter North Fork. Their target: Sen. Jim Borden. Their weapon: a Gatling gun.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Sharpshooter Marty Blair tries to persuade Lucas to buy Mark a rifle. After Lucas shoots a man during a robbery at the hotel, Mark and Lucas disagree with his character.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Fast-draw artist Wade Randall is in town, bragging of his gun battles with notorious bad men until one of them shows up to challenge his story.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Lucas refuses to sell his land, Mr. Prescott will stop at nothing to change his mind. He hires men to try to persuade Lucas, but he refuses.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark's careless actions cause the death of a friend. Unable to accept the truth, he blames the rifle and runs away from home. Soon, he is faced with a tough decision.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away. To maintain peace, Nils insists that anyone coming into town must turn in their weapons.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas's self-confidence begins to slip away when he misses an easy shot that could have cost Mark his life.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas is accused of the killing. When Lucas tries to help the boy, he finds himself on trial.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down. They help him bring his wagon to North Fork for repair.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Gridley Mau, the son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery, comes to North Fork looking for revenge.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The first railroad train is coming to the new North Fork station. Onboard is a Japanese nobleman and his servant, visiting the West to learn about the United States.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: At Halloween, rustlers take advantage of the seasonal disguises to raid a cattle ranch. Lucas' faith in his son's honesty is shaken when he hears rumors of Mark being mixed up with the thieves.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark and Lucas run into Micah on the trail and help when the prisoner he is transporting injures his arm. Lucas' life is endangered when a snake crawls into his bed.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy. Lucas is thrown into jail to stop him from murdering his former friend.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas is baffled when the marshal of a neighboring town refuses to hold a gambler who just attempted murder.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark is injured in an accident, leaving his legs paralyzed. At the doctor's suggestion, Lucas and Mark set out on a trek to Mission Springs.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mario Arsatti claims to be an acquaintance of a good friend from Lucas' past. But it's pleasure before business. Mario has been hired to kill Lucas.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas, who blames his wife's death on his father-in-law, refuses to help the old man elude a gang of gunmen.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The lazy Jackman brother's mortgage has been foreclosed. Unfit for farming, they head to a nearby town. The family patriarch becomes marshal and deputizes his sons.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark and his girlfriend discover that an old hermit is very lonely. Old Tony invites them to lunch and lets them look for arrowheads on a remote part of his land.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Cattle baron Oat Jackford orders his two cowboys to run Lucas McCain and his son off their ranch.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Mark gets caught on a mountain ledge, a young outlaw risks his life to rescue him and breaks his leg doing so.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Negan mantiene a Daryl encerrado en una celda, pero le propone que se someta a él y pasará a disfrutar de los privilegios de los que gozan los suyos. Se descubre el pasado de Dwight y por qué tiene la cara desfigurada.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los miembros del grupo de Alejandría están desmoralizados debido a los trágicos acontecimientos que acaban de ocurrir, pero al mismo tiempo deben prepararse para el encuentro con Negan. Este llega antes de lo previsto y les arrebata las armas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Afligidas por la pena y rodeadas de enemigos, Maggie y Sasha tratan de encontrar seguridad en Hilltop, pero allí no son bien recibidas por todos. En ese momento, los hombres de Negan llegan a Hilltop, adonde también se dirigen Carl y Enid.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tara llega a un poblado en el que solo viven unas peligrosas mujeres que no la dejarán salir de ahí fácilmente. Mientras tanto, Heath, quien la acompañaba en la búsqueda de provisiones, se pierde tratando de escapar de un ataque zombi.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carl se separa de Jesús y llega, oculto en un camión, a la guarida de los Saviors con la intención de matar a Negan. Mientras tanto, Rosita fuerza a Eugene a que le fabrique una bala y Michonne pone en marcha su propio plan contra Negan.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Negan continúa su visita a Alejandría. Spencer trata de entablar amistad con él para que lo designe líder de la comunidad, en lugar de Rick. Pero en ese momento Rick llega y se desencadena una serie de acontecimientos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Guiados por Jesús, Rick y sus compañeros llegan hasta la comunidad del rey Ezequiel, para buscar aliados en su lucha contra Negan. Allá se reencuentran con un viejo conocido.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras buscan a Gabriel, Rick y el grupo se topan con una misteriosa región cuyos habitantes son completamente diferentes a todo lo que han conocido hasta ahora.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Eugene, ahora en el cuartel general de los Salvadores, tiene que demostrar a Negan que vale la pena mantenerlo vivo. Mientras, Dwight es culpado de que Sherry haya permitido la fuga de Daryl y Negan le da una última oportunidad: encontrar a Sherry.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de Rick busca provisiones y armas con las que contentar a sus nuevos aliados en la lucha contra Negan. Mientras, Rosita está cada vez más impaciente por comenzar la guerra y en Alexandria, Tara deberá tomar una decisión trascendental.

Rookie catches his new friend , and together they set up an amazing building.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

All his friends are gathered around a cake with two candles, and at the little turtle’s count, they all join in singing ‘Happy Birthday’ together!

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.desc: Panique le soir d'Halloween : New York est envahi de vrais zombies, vampires et loups-garous. April et Casey sont contaminés.

programme.desc: Les tortues veulent tuer Dracula avant que Savanti ne s'en empare. Mais Raph est transformé en vampire et Savanti s'enfuit, emportant avec lui la momie, un loup-garou (le père d'Esméralda), Raph et Dracula.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La créature du docteur Frankenstein
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja partent en Allemagne en 1818 pour tenter d'arrêter Savanti Roméro, qui veut engager Frankenstein dans son armée. Ils échouent mais grace à Reinette les tortues retournent dans le futur pour une dernière tentative.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les monstres attaquent
programme.desc: La ville de New York est envahie par des monstres en tous genres. Les tortues, aidées de Reinette, tentent de déjouer le plan de Savanti Romero et de Dracula.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le choc des mondes, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Un vaisseau se dirige vers la Terre. Le lieutenant Iguissg'ba et le commandant Gazéwroka ont reçu l'ordre de prendre en chasse un mercenaire en cavale, K'Vathrak, qui n'est autre que le Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le choc des mondes, 2e partie
programme.desc: Mikey a pris une décharge électrique fatale. Dregg débarque sur la planète avec son vaisseau, les tortues tentent par tous les moyens de sauver le monde.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les aventures des Tortues Ninja (1/3)
programme.desc: Les tortues pensent être parvenues à vaincre leurs anciens ennemis, mais elles vont vite s'apercevoir qu'un nouveau mal est à l'œuvre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les aventures des Tortues Ninja (2/3)
programme.desc: À la recherche du Kuro Kabuto, Karaï se prétend héritière légitime du Clan des Foot quand elle tombe nez à nez avec un vieux rival.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les aventures des Tortues Ninja (3/3)
programme.desc: L'animosité de Donatello envers Don Vizioso met la mission des tortues en péril.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Yojimbo
programme.desc: Les tortues débarquent dans un monde féodal peuplé d'animaux anthropomorphes.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Pour sauver Alex
programme.desc: Alex est enlevée et retenue en otage dans les montagnes de l'Utah lors d'un voyage en camping, Walker doit retrouver sa fiancée bien-aimée et la sauver avant qu'il ne soit trop tard.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Une second chance
programme.desc: Pour venger l’un des leurs tombé lors d’une fusillade accidentelle, des terroristes de l’IRA kidnappent la fille malade d’Adam McGuire (guest-star Michael Beck) pour ne la rendre qu’avec la révocation de l'accord de paix irlandais dont il est à l’origine.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: L'ouest sauvage
programme.desc: À l’anniversaire de Walker, C.D. lui offre le journal des débuts de Hayes Cooper et conte la fois où Cooper a empêché un trio de desperados d'attaquer des colons mormons dans les montagnes de l'Utah au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Une étoile est née
programme.desc: Walker rencontre une gentille et talentueuse adolescente de 16 ans qui s’est frottée à un mauvais garçon et l'aide à croire en elle-même pour réaliser son rêve de devenir chanteuse.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Mauvais flics
programme.desc: Walker doit venir en aide aux habitants d'une petite ville frontalière sous l’emprise du shérif qui règne par la violence et le chantage.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: L'arme du crime
programme.desc: Après la mort par balle d’un flic de Dallas, le coupable impute le crime au neveu innocent de Carlos, Jesse. Walker doit prouver son innocence pour lui sauver la vie.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Un témoin très spécial
programme.desc: Walker doit arrêter le tueur à gages qui a poignardé Trent avant qu’il ne mette la main sur la fille handicapée mentale qui a été témoin de l'attaque.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Monsieur le principal
programme.desc: Après le « suicide » inattendu d’un proviseur d'un lycée qui enquêtait sur un réseau de drogue au sein de son établissement, Walker tente de découvrir la vérité sur la mort de son vieil ami et de rétablir l'ordre sur le campus envahi par les dealers.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Hors circuit (1ère partie)
programme.desc: Walker doit découvrir qui essaie de semer la zizanie dans une équipe amérindienne de course automobile en pleine préparation pour un événement majeur.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Hors circuit (2ème partie)
programme.desc: Lorsque le pilote de la voiture de l'équipe Cherokee est mis à l'écart, Walker doit prendre le volant pour éviter la disqualification de l’équipe.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Catalogue interdit
programme.desc: Pas une minute à perdre pour les Rangers lorsque la nouvelle petite amie de Trivette est enlevée par une bande de trafiquants d’êtres humains sur Internet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Les eaux de la vengeance
programme.desc: Lorsque qu’Alex et Trivette sont enlevés par l'ennemi juré de Walker et mis dans un réservoir d'eau glacée, Walker vole à leur rescousse.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Frères d'armes
programme.desc: Walker et Trivette tombent des nues lorsqu’ils découvrent que le cerveau d’un trafic de drogues et d’armes est le frère de Trivette avec qui il n’a plus de contacts depuis longtemps.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La machination
programme.desc: Alors que Walker et Trivette sont sur la piste d'un criminel évadé, C.D. enquête sur la mort suspecte du fils de son ami.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Au sommet de l'échelle
programme.desc: Walker, Trivette et Alex doivent protéger un quartier contre un gang de pyromanes qui intimident les témoins et tentent de tuer les pompiers dans l’exercice de leurs fonctions.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La bonne parole
programme.desc: Walker et Trivette cherchent à arrêter un usurier qui fait dans les personnalités et exploite le fils d'un ministre.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Au nom du crime (1ère partie)
programme.desc: Walker et Alex sont piégés à bord d’un avion qui s’est écrasé sur un lac isolé et qui est sur le point de couler.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger

Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.desc: The best way to learn is by doing, especially in Hawaiʻi. Teaming up with locals like Chef Mark "Gooch" Noguchi, Nathan Florence, and Jack Johnson, the DIRT crew dove headfirst into the rugged microclimates and deep-rooted cultures that define the islands. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Season 8 Episode 3 kicks off our first open-water shoot of the year as Paul Ethier and Jeff Shippam make their way to the legendary Mattagami Lake for some classic spring walleye action. With competitive tournaments on pause this season, the guys revisit their favourite early-season hotspots—areas they’d normally fish under pressure—now with time to explore, adapt, and enjoy the day. From structure-hopping to dialing in the spring pattern, Paul and Jeff put their tournament instincts to work for a fun, relaxed day chasing hungry post-spawn walleye in Northern Ontario.

programme.title: FishON! | Trailblazing to Trophy Walleye: Polaris Ranger Adventure
programme.desc: Join the FishON! TV crew as we tackle rugged Northern Ontario terrain with our Polaris Ranger equipped with a custom boat rack. This remote expedition takes us deep into the wilderness to an untouched lake known for its walleye bounty. From the adrenaline of the journey to the thrill of the catch, this episode is packed with adventure, stunning scenery, and fishing tips you won’t want to miss!

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Rana Indravadhan visits his home on a horse and seeing this, his mother Rajmata is left shocked. She asks Indravadhan the reason for coming on a horse but the latter does not inform her about the incident that occurred while he was on his way home. A curious Rajmata learns about the incident from the men who accompanied Indravadhan and decides to take action on the guilty. Indravadhan asks his mother to relax and exclaims that death would hug him soon. On the other hand, Gayatri's mother scolds her daughter. She scolds her for pushing the flower pot before Indravadhan's chariot. More of Gayatri's mother's character is revealed to the viewers in this episode. Keep watching to find out.Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal, but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri prays to god and sings a devotional song. Amidst this, she finds her father's room's door closed and decides to check on him. Gopal Seth replies that he was asleep until her sweet voice woke him up. On the other hand, Indaravadhan takes blessings from his mother Rajmata and invites her for the breakfast.
